components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default high-emphasis action: compact, neutral, and decisive.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary, hsl(240 5.9% 10%)); color: var(--primary-foreground, hsl(0 0% 98%)); font: 500 14px/1 "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart), box-shadow 150ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in hsl, var(--primary, hsl(240 5.9% 10%)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action that retains a precise structural edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--input, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--background, hsl(0 0% 100%)); color: var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); font: 500 14px/1 "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart), color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%)); color: var(--accent-foreground, hsl(240 5.9% 10%)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet utility action that becomes visible through interaction.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); font: 500 14px/1 "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart), color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--accent, hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%)); color: var(--accent-foreground, hsl(240 5.9% 10%)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: color-mix(in hsl, var(--accent, hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%)) 80%, var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%))); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact canvas-matched field with a crisp neutral focus treatment.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" value="Software Engineer" aria-label="Wanted job title">
components.css: .ds-input { width: 320px; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); font: 400 14px/1.4 "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%)); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: A compact, gently rounded label for template and local-storage metadata.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in hsl, var(--border, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--muted, hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%)); color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%)); font: 500 11px/1.25 "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart), color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--border, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)); color: var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-emerald-500, oklch(69.6% 0.17 162.48)); }

components.name: Document Card
components.description: The canonical interactive record card for locally stored resumes.
components.css: .ds-document-card { width: 280px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card, hsl(0 0% 100%)); color: var(--card-foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms var(--ease-out-quart), border-color 200ms var(--ease-out-quart), box-shadow 200ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-document-card strong { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-document-card span { color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%)); font-size: 12px; } .ds-document-card small { padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)); color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%)); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-document-card:hover { background: color-mix(in hsl, var(--accent, hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%)) 30%, var(--card, hsl(0 0% 100%))); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-document-card:focus-within { outline: 1px solid var(--ring, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-document-card:active { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: A compact application destination with neutral active-state emphasis.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 220px; height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, hsl(240 5.3% 26.1%)); font: 400 14px/1 "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms linear, color 200ms linear; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--sidebar-accent, hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, hsl(240 5.9% 10%)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--sidebar-ring, hsl(217.2 91.2% 59.8%)); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-item:active, .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--sidebar-accent, hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, hsl(240 5.9% 10%)); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A focused overlay for short protected decisions and forms.
components.html:
Rename document

Choose a clear title for this resume.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 420px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background, hsl(0 0% 100%)); color: var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-dialog p { margin: -8px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%)); font-size: 14px; } .ds-dialog > div { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-dialog button { height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/1 "Instrument Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out-quart); } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1px solid var(--input, hsl(240 5.9% 90%)); background: var(--background, hsl(0 0% 100%)); color: var(--foreground, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); } .ds-dialog-save { border: 0; background: var(--primary, hsl(240 5.9% 10%)); color: var(--primary-foreground, hsl(0 0% 98%)); } .ds-dialog button:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring, hsl(240 10% 3.9%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dialog button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

narrative.overview:
ZenCV should feel like a private, well-kept studio for consequential work: calm enough to reduce job-search stress, polished enough to build confidence, and precise enough to make dense editing feel manageable. The interface recedes behind the resume. It uses a restrained monochrome foundation, disciplined spacing, compact controls, and selective editorial scale rather than ornamental branding.

The experience is professional without becoming corporate. Light and dark themes are equal expressions of the same system, and both preserve a paper-and-ink relationship between canvas and content. Color is semantic and rare. Motion confirms state or guides attention; it never turns the workspace into a playful SaaS demo. Avoid corporate-blue dominance, AI-neon effects, glassmorphism, and decorative gradients.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet monochrome chrome that keeps the document visually dominant.
Strong editorial hierarchy paired with compact, practical controls.
Paper-like light surfaces and ink-like dark surfaces with clear theme parity.
Fine borders and tonal shifts before shadow.
Direct, reassuring interaction language with visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Document Leads Rule
rules.body: Application chrome stays neutral so templates, user-selected accents, and resume content remain the visual subject.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated color must communicate privacy, warning, error, progress, or template choice; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The No Synthetic Glow Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce neon gradients, luminous AI treatments, or blue-purple glow effects.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Use Instrument Sans throughout the application shell; resume templates own their independent print typography.

rules.name: The Editorial Jump Rule
rules.body: Large display type is earned by persuasive or orienting moments. Operational screens use compact titles and strong grouping instead.

rules.name: The Workbench Split Rule
rules.body: Optimize the builder first for a genuinely usable desktop editor/preview split. Below that threshold, prioritize one view at a time and preserve the mobile tasks that matter most: review, light editing, and export.

rules.name: The Tight Controls, Open Sections Rule
rules.body: Operational density belongs inside controls and field groups. Section boundaries and page transitions receive the breathing room.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Needed Rule
rules.body: A surface earns additional shadow only when it floats, opens, or responds to interaction.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: Prefer a border or a shadow as the dominant edge treatment; avoid heavy borders under broad shadows.

rules.name: The Purposeful Pill Rule
rules.body: Do not turn ordinary buttons, cards, or fields into capsules. Reserve full rounding for status, paging, and compact toggles.

dos: Do keep the resume or template preview visually dominant over application chrome.
Do use Studio Ink, Paper White, and Quiet Slate for most interface decisions.
Do reserve saturated colors for semantic states and user-selected template accents.
Do preserve equal-quality light and dark themes.
Do use borders and tonal layering before increasing shadow.
Do keep operational controls compact while giving sections generous separation.
Do provide visible hover, focus, disabled, loading, error, and empty states.
Do keep motion short, purposeful, and compatible with reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't turn ZenCV into a playful SaaS interface with bubbly cards, mascot energy, or novelty copy.
Don't make corporate blue the default action or navigation color.
Don't use AI-neon, blue-purple glow, glassmorphism, or decorative gradients.
Don't let application accents compete with resume-template colors.
Don't use pills for ordinary buttons, inputs, or cards.
Don't add shadow to every container or stack heavy borders beneath broad shadows.
Don't use uppercase tracked labels as a universal heading pattern.
